# Lab 12.6: Protect a Web App with IAP

## What We Are Going to Do
Deploy a Cloud Run service, put Identity-Aware Proxy in front of it, and allow only one group to open it.

## Steps

1. **Enable the APIs.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable run.googleapis.com iap.googleapis.com
export PROJECT_NUMBER=$(gcloud projects describe $PROJECT_ID --format="value(projectNumber)")</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Deploy a sample service with IAP turned on.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud run deploy iap-lab \
  --region=us-central1 \
  --image=us-docker.pkg.dev/cloudrun/container/hello \
  --no-allow-unauthenticated \
  --iap</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Let IAP call the service.** The IAP service agent needs the invoker role. The console does this for you; with gcloud you add it:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud run services add-iam-policy-binding iap-lab \
  --region=us-central1 \
  --member=serviceAccount:service-$PROJECT_NUMBER@gcp-sa-iap.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/run.invoker</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Allow one group through IAP.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iap web add-iam-policy-binding \
  --resource-type=cloud-run \
  --service=iap-lab \
  --region=us-central1 \
  --member=group:gcp-developers@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=roles/iap.httpsResourceAccessor</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Test it.** Open the service URL in a private window.
   - As Alice (in `gcp-developers`): you sign in and see the page.
   - As Sam (not in the group): **You don't have access**.

6. **Add context.** In **Security → Identity-Aware Proxy**, open the service's access settings and add an IAM condition using the `office_ip` access level from Lab 8.12.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud run services delete iap-lab --region=us-central1 --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Unauthenticated users | Sent to Google sign-in |
| Allowed group | Sees the app |
| Other users | Blocked by IAP |
| App changes | None needed |
